notes: Static pour-fill LN2 cryostat: no cryocooler, no pump inside the cryostat, no magnet; the only motion is LN2 boil-off vapour from the 400 mL top reservoir. Configured without VPF-PM pumping manifold so range is 77-500 K. Weight 3.3 kg (7 lb). The instrumentation adapter (brochure) carries a 10-pin electrical feedthrough, three spare o-ring sealed ports, an evacuation valve and a pressure relief valve; the wired variant WH-10P gives 10 PhBr twisted pairs. The stage temperature_K values are the 77 K base (both reservoir and mount sit at LN2 temperature when not heated). Window material default is fused silica (WR-STD-FS); sapphire, ZnSe, CaF2, KBr, TPX are 3 mm or 6 mm options.
